title: DSI transport failures can be reported as successful acquisition
summary: dsi_start_exposure discards setup/start command failures and marks exposing success. dsi_read_image checks transfer status but not actual image byte count, allowing short successful planes to decode retained/partial contents. Next: propagate setup/start failures, commit exposing state only after accepted start, enforce exact expected plane lengths and add fake transport failed-start/short-frame regressions. Source-only, no device execution.
